dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Hmph, that's what they'll get for being bad guys!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: The archon will let everyone know that you'll only be rewarded for being an awesome person like Yoimiya.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Yoimiya never ridicules me. She will offer me little fireworks for fun, and she encourages me to study hard... In my mind, she's the greatest person ever — besides my family, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Not like that big guy with the horns. He would play cards with me and win all of my snacks. Ugh, and I don't even have that many snacks to lose...
